format: single Pure Barre studio (typically 1,500 to 1,800 sq ft leased)

invest.quote: The total investment necessary to begin operation of a Pure Barre studio is $455,299 to $736,465, which includes $117,015 to $129,671 that must be paid to franchisor or its affiliates.

fee.quote: You must pay to us a lump sum initial franchise fee of $60,000 (the "Initial Franchise Fee") to establish a single Studio under a Franchise Agreement.
fee.note: VetFran veterans: $45,000. Existing franchisees: $50,000 for the 2nd franchise, $40,000 for the 3rd or more. Sourcing fee $28,000 (in addition) when a broker is owed a commission on an existing franchisee's additional franchise; $30,000 in lieu of the fee when buying an existing Studio through a broker. Multi-Unit Development Fee $10,000 per Studio less the first.

royalty.quote: Royalty 7% of Gross Sales generated by your Studio over the relevant reporting period Payable weekly via electronic funds transfer ("EFT") based on the Gross Sales of your Studio during the preceding business week

adFund.quote: Contributions to Brand Development Fund Currently, 2% of Gross Sales Payable weekly at the same time and in the same manner as the Royalty
adFund.note: Currently 2% Brand Development Fund; Local Advertising Requirement the greater of $1,500 or 2% of prior month's Gross Sales; Fund + Co-Op + local advertising capped in aggregate at 7% per month (Marketing Expenditure Cap).

otherRecurring.name: Technology Fee
otherRecurring.amount: Currently, $304/month (may increase by 50% annually); reduced $150 per month during Pre-Sales Phase

otherRecurring.name: Software Fee (Approved Supplier studio management software)
Local Advertising Requirement
otherRecurring.amount: The greater of (a) $1,500 or (b) 2% of the prior month's Gross Sales, monthly

otherRecurring.name: Mystery Shopper and Other Quality Control Programs

transferFee.amount: $10,000 Upon your request for our consent to any proposed transfer (administrative fee of $750 to an entity you fully own, or $1,500 to an immediate family member)

item19.note: Gross Revenue only, no costs or profit; defined differently from Gross Sales in the Franchise Agreement. 14 studios that opened in 2025 excluded; 14 studios that ceased operations in 2025 not included.

special: Fitness Equipment & Initial FF&E Package ($44,264 to $51,520), pre-opening items and Instructor Training ($8,850 to $13,750) are paid to the franchisor. Sourcing fees ($28,000 to $120,000) apply when a franchise broker is owed a commission. Technology Fee may increase by 50% annually.
issues: Item 7 does not state explicitly that real estate purchase is excluded (assumes leased premises); excludesRealEstate left null. Software Fee ($203/month) is paid to an Approved Supplier, not the franchisor.
